description: This Java source file defines the AuthHelper class, which manages authentication processes such as login, logout, user synchronization, and password updates within the Apache OFBiz framework. It loads and maintains a list of authenticators, handles security context, and provides utility methods for authentication workflows.

classes.name: AuthHelper
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for authentication management, including loading authenticators, user authentication, logout, synchronization, and password updates within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs user authentication by iterating through loaded authenticators; throws exception if authenticators are not loaded.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out a user across all loaded authenticators.

methods.name: syncUser
methods.description: Synchronizes user data across authenticators that support synchronization.

methods.name: updatePassword
methods.description: Updates the user's password across all authenticators.

methods.name: authenticatorsLoaded
methods.description: Returns whether authenticators have been loaded.

methods.name: loadAuthenticators
methods.description: Loads authenticators if not already loaded, using the provided dispatcher.

methods.name: loadAuthenticatorsInternal
methods.description: Internal synchronized method that loads authenticators via ServiceLoader, initializes them, and sorts the list.

methods.name: getContextClassLoader
methods.description: Retrieves the current thread's context class loader with security privileges.
